reviews.text: I like the service and the attention from the staff, and I like how they cut my dog's hair. My only complaint is that they ask for a tip when the service is already expensive; I find that annoying.

Dear Adriana, we'd love to hear about your experience so we can improve. If you could share it with us by emailing llaospet.socios@gmail.com, we would greatly appreciate it. We didn't receive any messages on our in-store WhatsApp to address your concerns, so please get in touch. We're here to listen.
They are very kind and caring with the furry ones. Excellent service and highly recommended. Karen is very friendly.
Great!! They've always taken great care of my pet.

Today they did a colorimetry treatment on my Toy Poodle's pom-poms and ears, and it turned out exactly how I wanted! The people who work there are so kind and love animals. The place is very safe to leave your pet with; I had complete confidence in them. I highly recommend them for all kinds of services. Very good prices for excellent quality. Thank you for everything! 🙏
The way they treat the dogs with love is unreal.

I had gone to have my dog ​​bathed multiple times and everything was fine, until yesterday when I made an appointment, which was scheduled for 9 a.m. I arrived and the place wasn't even open—a complete lack of respect and consideration for other people's time. Far from apologizing, they used the excuse that I hadn't sent them the vaccination record, but they didn't even have the courtesy to let me know they had canceled my appointment for that reason. Zero respect and customer service.

New to CDMX and had the best first grooming appointment for my senior dog Finnegan. Extremely easy to schedule via WhatsApp and the groomer was very sensitive to my senior dog’s needs. Terrific haircut. Highly recommend Llaos!!
